{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for the existence of the treatment arm
treatment_exists = 'treatment' in data['arm'].unique()

treatment_count = data['arm'].value_counts().get('treatment', 0)

# Check if responded is binary and valid
responded_is_binary = set(data['responded'].unique()).issubset({0, 1})

# Print results
treatment_exists, treatment_count, responded_is_binary"}
